Name: Cliffside Bonanza
Author: aldrichosaurusrex30
Description:
[A/N] Hello! Welcome to my 2nd farm map: CLIFFSIDE BONANZA! I made this farm with my playstyle and mods in mind and it turned out to be a very big map perfect for multiplayers! (I dont have friends to play with T^T) 

Scattered across the mountain cliff is a wide and fertile soil to farm! With 5 secret locations to discover that cater to your needs! (Or my needs to be exact XD) 2 of which are obviously in plain sight while the other 3 are hard to find.

Wish you could plant 170+ fruit trees on you farm? How about a place to tapp trees? What about a place where you can cask tons of wines and put your artisan machines? Ready your tools and explore this vast map!

Known issues:
~The dirt under the greenhouse when moving.
~You can only catch mountain fish on the main farm, everywhere else is trash but you can put crabpots anywhere.

Side notes:
~Standard map is the default farm map to replace. Choose on GMCM before making a new save. 
~Everything seems to work as intented.
~The Secret Greenhouse is a little bit wonky. It's marked as Outside so yes it rains inside BUT you can place Beehouses, Solar panels and Lightning Rods.
~Big thanks to Tlitookilakin for the greenhouse panel assets!
~And Yes, everything is tillable.
~IF USING VPR DO NOT CHOOSE THE BEACH AS A REPLACEMENT! (thank you hanxue246 for pointing this out!)
